name: Harîmî (Prince Qorqud)
bio: Prince Qorqud, who wrote under the pen-name Harimi, was a son of Sultan Bayezid II and a brother of Selim I.
The poems here are taken from E. J. W. Gibb's Ottoman Poems (1882), the first English verse translations of Ottoman poetry; dates and biographical details follow Gibb's Biographical Notices.

poems.title: Both Crown and Robe Forsake Shall
poems.author: Harîmî (Prince Qorqud)
